Eye Pattern - Full Heterochromia.description:
👁️ Eye Pattern: Full Heterochromia
Each eye is a completely different color — one iris in your primary eye color, the other in your secondary eye color.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Eye Pattern - Full Heterochromia.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Each eye is a completely different color — one iris the primary eye color, the other the secondary eye color. Apply full heterochromia to the eyes using primary and secondary eye colors. Do not turn this into active power use.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
